title: CreeperChestSave
description: Chests don't explode but blocks do.
body:
Creepers can't blow up chests with this plugin.

It is designed to not make the game too easy (creepers can still break blocks) but not frustrating too.

By default, explosions do:
- Can't break **Chests** (any storage block e.g. barrel, hopper).
- Can't destroy Armor Stands.
- Can't destroy Item Frames.
- Can't damage **Pets** (tamed Wolves, cats etc.).
- Can't damage villagers.
- **Can** break blocks.
### Note
All of these above are configurable.
